description: This file defines the LDAPTestSyncService class, which extends LDAPSyncService to handle LDAP synchronization with testing-specific LDAP service implementation. It contains methods to initialize LDAP service with specific settings, including potentially binding with user credentials, for LDAP testing purposes.

classes.name: LDAPTestSyncService
classes.description: A service class for testing LDAP synchronization, extending LDAPSyncService, using LDAPTestService for LDAP operations, configured with specific LDAP settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LDAPTestSyncService with specified LDAP settings.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Returns the LDAP service instance, initializing it if necessary, and performs binding with credentials based on settings.

methods.name: getLDAPSetting
methods.description: Returns the LDAP setting object associated with this service.
